validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: solidly real, NOT GEM-only. The sheet's own primary ref (attaqa.net 2025-04-03, verified live) genuinely names the pipeline: PM al-Sudani and Oil Minister Abdul-Ghani inspected the dry-gas line from Mahmudiyah district (قضاء المحمودية) to Besmaya power station, 43 km, 42-inch (قطر 42 عقدة), ~800 MMscf/d. Independently corroborated by thenewregion.com (2025-04-03: 43 km, 42-in, 800 MMscf/d, 75% complete, Oil Projects Company, 120-day target), iina.news (2025-03-18: 43 km, 800 MMscf/d, Oil Projects Company executor; and 2025-05-13: 42-in valve tie-in), alrasheedmedia.com (2025-03-09 cabinet decision to build), and attaqa.net (2025-08-11). The 'existing_ref_checks' failure on Status [ref] was a tooling artifact (English token 'construction' searched against an Arabic page), not link rot. CLASSIFICATION: correct — 42-inch dry-gas transmission trunk feeding Besmaya power station; commodity gas confirmed; transmission (not gathering/feeder) appropriate for a 43 km 42-in line tied into the national gas grid. DUPLICATE: no — compared against all 16 in-scope Iraq gas rows; nothing else is Baghdad-area Mahmudiyah–Besmaya (P7470 Karbala and P7460/66/67 Okaz–Anbar are distinct corridors; all others are southern/Kurdistan lines). ATTRIBUTION: Operator = Oil Projects Co (SCOP) CONFIRMED by thenewregion + iina (both name Oil Projects Company / SCOP as executor); Owner = Iraq Ministry of Oil consistent (ministry-directed project). CAVEAT (the one real error found): sheet StartState/Province = 'Babylon' is wrong — Mahmudiyah district (قضاء المحمودية) is a district of BAGHDAD Governorate, not Babylon; all independent Arabic sources place the start in qada' al-Mahmudiyah, and the route (Baghdad–Hillah road, Tigris at Sayafiyah, Baghdad–Kut road) is entirely greater Baghdad. The 'Babylon province' claim appears only on GEM-derived surfaces. SPEC: Diameter 42 in — confirmed by >=3 independent sources (high). Capacity 800 MMcf/d — confirmed by attaqa + thenewregion + iina (high). Length 43 km — confirmed by attaqa + thenewregion (high), though the ministry's later completion-phase statements (attaqa 2025-08-11) round to '40 km' and one July 2025 report said 45 km; 43 km remains the best-attested figure. ConstructionYear 2025 — confirmed: cabinet ordered the line 2025-03-09, minister said SCOP began work in month 3 of 2025, 75% done by early April 2025.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Sheet says construction (LastUpdated 2025-07-14). Newer dated evidence: Oil Minister Hayyan Abdul-Ghani announced on 2025-07-20 (Baghdad Today exclusive, verified) that the Mahmudiyah–Besmaya line was 'completed in full' (الخط أنجز بالكامل) despite route obstacles (bores >20 m deep, river crossing, silos/buildings on the corridor). Independently, attaqa.net 2025-08-11 (verified; separate origin, cites ministry/electricity statements) reports the ~40 km Mahmudiyah–Besmaya gas line was implemented over the preceding months so Besmaya station could run at full capacity in summer 2025 — the same period the plant reached 5,000 MW with unit 13 inaugurated (Aug 2025). SCOP finished the Tigris HDD crossing in May 2025 (iraq-businessnews 2025-05-25 — returns HTTP 401 to the verifier, so not cited as a ref). Construction started March 2025; the line was purpose-built for summer 2025 gas delivery to Besmaya; official completion 2025-07 + the plant's full-capacity operation in Aug 2025 support 'operating' with StartYear1=2025. Caveat: no single article says 'first gas flowed through the new pipe on date X' — the change rests on the official completion announcement plus plant-supply reporting; both refs verified live. Searched English + Arabic through July 2026; no later contradicting news (no reports of the line idle, damaged, or incomplete).

fills.researcher_notes: ConstructionYear=2025 had no ref. Al-Rasheed Media 2025-03-09 (verified): government decision to lay the new Mahmudiyah–Besmaya gas line ahead of summer; the Oil Minister later stated SCOP began work in month 3 of 2025 (Baghdad Today 2025-07-20 coverage), so ConstructionMonth=3 proposed. The New Region 2025-04-03 (verified): line already 75% complete in April 2025, corroborating a March 2025 construction start.

Location [ref] was blank. Both verified sources name the endpoints: dry gas from qada' al-Mahmudiyah (قضاء المحمودية) to Besmaya power station. IMPORTANT VALUE CORRECTION bundled with this fill: sheet has StartState/Province='Babylon', but Mahmudiyah district is administratively part of BAGHDAD Governorate — propose 'Baghdad'. Route (per completion coverage) crosses under the Baghdad–Hillah road, the Tigris at Sayafiyah, and the Baghdad–Kut road, all within greater Baghdad.

Operator [ref] was blank (operators/owners tab row 5806). Two independent verified sources name the State Company for Oil Projects (Oil Projects Company / SCOP) as the executing company: The New Region 2025-04-03 and IINA 2025-03-18 ('Ministry of Oil overseer, Oil Projects Company executor'). Note SCOP is the state EPC arm — it built the line; post-completion operation of the gas grid normally sits with the Oil/Gas Pipelines Company (IINA 2025-05-13 also credits Oil Pipelines Company in the valve tie-in), so 'Operator = Oil Projects Co' may warrant review now that the line is in service.

summary: P7434 confirmed real (multi-source, high tier); specs 43 km / 42 in / 800 MMcf/d all corroborated; status change construction -> operating (completed 2025-07-20 per Oil Minister, supplying Besmaya by Aug 2025); one attribution fix: StartState/Province Babylon -> Baghdad; filled Construction, Location, Operator refs.
